Lemma
[Ricci evolution in dimension three] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0190 1. Lemma 6.10\group evolution-of-curvature-under-the-ricci-flow

In dimension $n=3$, the Ricci tensor of a solution to the Ricci flow evolves by \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}R_{jk}=\Delta R_{jk}+3RR_{jk}-6g^{pq}R_{jp}R_{qk}+\bigl(2|\Rc |^2-R^2\bigr)g_{jk}. \]
